AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 106 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7826, #7827, #7828, #7829 and #7830:

- #7826 → #5780: `audit:complete` (native Android client design).
- #7827 → #7823: `audit:complete` (image upload response-shape validation).
- #7828 → #5846: `audit:complete` (Evernote importer design).
- #7829 → #7093: `audit:complete` (yard-reaper apply-loop fix and end-to-end test; final completion after #7820).
- #7830: `audit:no-issue` (directly ordered OpenCode Go account/config addition; retroactive home #10079).

The PR bodies, diffs, comments, source issue/comment captures, later-fix evidence, verdicts and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7826-7830/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7826-7830.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 106 valid PRs audited from 110 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 140 identifiers remain, next #7832. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
